description:
Key Skills:  
 Core Java/J2EE development  

 Thorough OO Analysis and Design in Java  

 Strong MySQL development (admin skills a bonus)  

 Strong understanding of Web Service Development - SOAP, RESTful, JSON, SOA  

 Spring, Hibernate, JPA  

 ESB development (preferably MuleSoft)  

 

 Experience:  
 Understanding Application Servers JBOSS,Apache Tomcat  

 Comfortable on Linux (CentOs, RedHat)  

 CMS - Subversion, Git  

 Understanding of Agile Development and Methodologies  

 Requirements:  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or 6+ years of equivalent experience in related disciplines. Master’s degree preferred.  

 Demonstrated technical capabilities and ability to work collaboratively and effectively with a range of stakeholders  

 6+ years of experience with Java/JEE and related technologies  

 Knowledge of developing trends and emerging standards in relevant fields  

 Strong background in object-oriented architectures and development  

 Understanding of the software development life-cycle (SDLC)  

 Attention to detail and strong organization skills  

 Strong communication skills for working with third-parties  

 If this role is of interest to you please send me an updated resume. 


 ESB, Mulesoft, Web Services, SOAP, RESTful 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
